michael-romanov-elected-tsar.description: A painting of a night scene in snow at a stone monastery gate lit by torches. A slim youth in a dark tunic stands in an open doorway while a woman in a black veil sits behind him. Kneeling men in fur-trimmed brocade robes and fur hats face him, and a bearded cleric in gold vestments raises a gilded icon of the Virgin and Child. Black-robed clergy kneel with scrolls, and a crowd of townsfolk holds torches. Onion domes and a wooden gallery sit in the background.

peter-and-ivan-co-tsars.description: Two young boys sit side by side on ornate silver thrones in a dark, gilded hall. The boy on the left wears a jeweled crown and a heavy gold-and-jewel brocade robe, and the boy on the right wears a silver-and-gold robe and holds a scepter. A veiled, dark-clad woman peeks out from a half-open door between the thrones, and bearded men in kaftans stand in the shadows at the sides. Double-headed eagle emblems are carved on the thrones' high backs and hang on the wall above. There are no visible letters, and the painting runs edge to edge.

peter-great-embassy-europe.description: A dark-haired man in a grey shirt and brown leather apron swings an axe-like tool at a large timber beam in a workshop, with wood shavings flying. Other workers are in the background, one carrying a plank over his shoulder. A ship's wooden hull and rigging rise at the right, and a warm light glows from a doorway. The scene is a painted, realistic workshop with no visible text, frame or border.

founding-st-petersburg.description: Ragged workers in muddy water haul a log with ropes and drive a wooden pile into a marsh by a wide grey river. Behind them, an earthen fortress wall with small figures and scaffolding sits under heavy storm clouds. No text or frame is visible.

peter-proclaimed-emperor.description: A tall man with dark curled hair and a moustache stands on a raised step in a green coat with red cuffs and gold buttons, in a vaulted stone hall with columns and banners. Around him, men in long coats and powdered wigs bow or read from scrolls. On a velvet cushion on a draped table at right sit a crown and an orb. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text, border or wall.

elizabeth-seizes-russian-throne.description: A woman in a black fur-trimmed gown and silver breastplate, wearing a tricorn hat and a blue sash, points forward while holding a torch-lit procession of soldiers in green coats with red facings and tall gold-topped caps. It is night and snowing. A columned neoclassical building stands at the right edge. No visible text, frame or border.

russia-annexes-crimea.description: A three-masted sailing ship rides at anchor in a bay under a cliff face, with smaller vessels nearby. On the right, men in dark coats and tricorn hats and workers in shirtsleeves haul ropes and stack timber on a wooden pier and scaffolding. A flag with a double-headed eagle flies from a platform, and fires and smoke burn on the shore under a dramatic sky. No visible text, frame or border.

paul-i-assassinated.description: A dim palace corridor with a carved wooden door ajar. A man in a dark bicorne-style uniform with red facings and white breeches holds a candle aloft. Several officers in dark uniforms, bicorne hats with white plumes and epaulettes, with swords drawn, crowd toward the doorway. One officer in the foreground stands with his back turned. Gilt-edged paintings hang on the walls and a vaulted hall recedes into shadow. No visible text, frame or violence.

decembrist-revolt.description: A winter square at dusk or night. A bronze statue of a rearing horse and rider stands on a large granite boulder at right. Rows of soldiers in dark green coats and tall shako caps hold muskets, and some carry torches. An officer on a brown horse sits at the lower left. In the background are cannons with smoke, a domed cathedral with a gold dome, and a neoclassical building. There is no visible text, no frame, and no blood.

tsarskoye-selo-railway-opens.description: A early steam locomotive with a tall black chimney and a glowing headlamp runs along a track through a flat landscape of birch trees. Behind it, open carriages carry men in top hats and frock coats and a few women in bonnets, with a man in a cap at the controls. Thick smoke and sparks rise from the funnel. In the right background is a pale classical pavilion with lit arched windows, and a crowd stands near it under a dusk sky. No visible text, frame or border.

tolstoy-war-and-peace-completed.description: A tall stack of loose, deckled paper sheets sits on a dark wooden desk, with a quill pen resting across the top page, which has faint handwritten-looking lines. A lit candle in a brass holder and an open inkwell sit to the right, with pen nibs beside them. Through a window behind, a snowy village shows at night. The painting is dark, warm and painterly, with no visible frame or border.

faberge-first-imperial-egg.description: A dark-gloved hand lifts the top half of a white enamel egg with a gold rim, revealing a gold yolk-like cup with a small gold hen inside. The egg sits on a crimson velvet cushion on a wooden workbench, surrounded by pliers, picks, a small metal cup and a gold ring at the bottom edge. The background is dark and the style is painterly oil. No visible text.

trans-siberian-railway-begun.description: A painted forest scene with a railway track running straight into the distance between tall pines and birches. In the foreground, a man in a rough light tunic heaves a wooden sleeper, while several workers in flat caps and dark long coats swing hammers and spike tools at the rails. A figure in a peaked cap and dark coat stands behind them, gesturing. Logs and debris lie in the clearing, snow patches on the ground, and a steam locomotive with a plume of smoke is visible far down the line under an overcast sky. No text or frame is visible.

nicholas-ii-becomes-tsar.description: A jewelled imperial crown with a red stone sits on a black velvet cushion, lit by a tall candle at its right. Behind it a black cloth with embroidered eagle motifs drapes over a shape, and to the left and right dark-robed, veiled figures stand with bowed heads. The background is a gilded Orthodox iconostasis with painted icons and more candles, all in a dim, smoky interior. No text, border or frame is visible; the painting runs edge to edge.

bloody-sunday-st-petersburg.description: A painted scene of a large crowd of bearded men in dark coats and caps holding icons, crosses and religious banners in snow before a large pale green and white baroque palace. In the foreground a man in a black greatcoat raises his arm facing a line of soldiers in fur hats aiming rifles from the right. Winter, snow, overcast sky, bare trees. No visible text, no frame, no bodies.

russia-enters-world-war-one.description: A crowded railway station under an iron-and-glass arched roof. Soldiers in khaki field uniforms with rolled bedrolls and rifles climb onto a dark passenger train, with a steam locomotive and smoke at right. Women in shawls, a woman holding a baby, and a boy reach up toward the men on the platform, with bundles and lamps around them. No visible text, no frame, no blood.

rasputin-murdered.description: A dark, night-time painting of a bridge with heavy iron trusses and ice-crusted piers over a frozen river. A black open patch of water sits in the ice, with broken ice slabs around it. In the foreground a single dark fur-trimmed boot lies on the snow. Distant lamps glow faintly on the far bank. No figures, no text, no frame.
